system.description:
ADEPT

Knowing exactly what is being cast gives you an instant to prepare the right defence.
When you successfully identify a spell or magical effect before attempting a saving throw against it, you gain advantage on the saving throw.
This is in addition to any bonus already received from Spell Recognition.

Prerequisites Spellcraft 5 ranks, Spell Recognition

Works automatically: advantage is offered on saves with the book's wording — tick when you identified the spell first.

conditionals.label: Spell-Wise Defence
conditionals.scope: A saving throw against a spell or magical effect you successfully identified before attempting it
